📌 Strategic Direction (this week)

Double down on Arabic Messages campaigns + inject competitor-proven content angles into organic. Last week's data confirms the trend: your Arabic Messages ads ("تدور استشارة" and "كل يوم يمر") are crushing it at 2.58-3.89% CTR and $0.33-$1.09 CPC, while English Awareness ads bleed budget at $1.73-$2.75 CPC. Organic engagement remains weak (141-213 likes = 0.2-0.3% ER), but @evainteriors (1168 likes, 0.14% ER) and @imperium.uae (666 likes) prove storytelling beats renderings. This week: (1) Scale top 2 Arabic Messages ads to $500/day combined, (2) Kill Sharjah Awareness ad ($1181 spend, 0.08% CTR), (3) Test 3 competitor-inspired angles organically—warmth/hospitality (EVA), plot-as-opportunity (Imperium), material honesty deep-dive.

📅 Posting Schedule (next 7 days)

DayFormatTopic / AngleTierCaption DirectionHashtags
Mon 6pmCarousel (8 slides)"The 11 Decisions Before We Draw a Line" — client intake to concept, inspired by your top-performing "What happens before..." post (213 likes)SignatureAR: "التصميم الفاخر ما يبدأ بالرسم، يبدأ بـ 11 قرار استراتيجي. شوف العملية الكاملة. استشارة: 0551299880"#DubaiArchitecture #LuxuryVillaUAE #KhalesSignature
Tue 7pmReel (35sec)Al Saqer master suite walkthrough (your 572-like post) + Arabic voiceover: "Why woven textures cost 3x more"EliteAR+EN: "المواد الطبيعية تصنع الفرق. This is why Elite clients choose Khales. DM us."#LuxuryInteriorDubai #DubaiHomes #KhalesElite
Wed 5pmCarousel (6 slides)"A Majlis Designed for Hospitality" — steal EVA's warmth angle (1168 likes), show your version with blush/neutral tonesSignatureAR: "المجلس مش مساحة بس، هو تجربة ضيافة. شوف كيف نصمم دفء حقيقي."#DubaiLuxury #MajlisDesign #LuxuryInteriorDubai
Fri 6pmCarousel (7 slides)"We Don't Fix Sloped Plots — We Celebrate Them" — Imperium's angle (666 likes), show before/after with levels/terracingSignatureEN: "Most see an uneven plot as a problem. We see it as an architectural opportunity. Here's how."#DubaiArchitecture #VillaDesign #LuxuryVillaUAE
Sun 7pmStatic (high-res)Single hero shot of Al Hamad Villa facade at golden hour — classical symmetry (your 141-like post angle)EliteAR: "العمارة الكلاسيكية ما تموت، تتطور. هذا مشروع العامد. DM للاستشارة الخاصة."#ClassicalVilla #DubaiHomes #KhalesElite

💰 Ad Recommendations

Continue / Scale

  • Arabic Messages ad "تدور استشارة في التصميم الداخلي؟" — 2.58% CTR, $0.33 CPC, $1119 spend → Scale to $300/day. Best-performing ad by 3x.
  • Arabic Messages ad "كل يوم يمر بدون تصميم صحيح" — 3.89% CTR, $1.09 CPC, $1046 spend → Scale to $200/day. Highest CTR, urgency-driven copy works.
  • Messages ad "Stop scrolling and start dreaming" — 2.51% CTR, $0.50 CPC → Keep at $50/day. Good CTR, test Arabic version of same angle.

Pause / Kill

  • Awareness ad "New Awareness ad" (Sharjah) — $1181 spend, 0.08% CTR, $1.73 CPC → KILL immediately. 50x worse than Messages ads, burning budget.
  • Awareness ads "Ad2" / "Ad Awareness" / "Awareness Ad" — $326-$223 spend, 0.08-0.11% CTR, $2.00-$2.75 CPC → Pause all. CPC too high for awareness objective.
  • Engagement ad "Instagram post: Some homes just take your breath..." — $660 spend, 0.14% CTR, $2.71 CPC → Pause. Engagement objective isn't converting, pivot creative to Messages.

New Campaign to Launch

Objective: Messages | Audience: AE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah), 30-55, interests: luxury real estate, interior design, home renovation | Creative: Carousel ad in Arabic: "3 أخطاء تصميم تكلف أصحاب الفلل ملايين (وكيف تتجنبها)" — 5 slides showing common mistakes (bad lighting, wrong materials, no flow) + CTA "احجز استشارة مجانية: 0551299880" | Hashtags: None (ads don't need hashtags) | Daily budget: $100/day for 7 days, evaluate on Day 5.

🎨 Creative Direction

  • Steal EVA's warmth language: Your posts are cold/technical ("scale and material honesty"). EVA's top post uses "warmth, elegance, hospitality" — test emotional framing on 2 posts this week.
  • Show the problem first: Imperium's 666-like post starts with "uneven plot = problem" then flips it. Your posts skip the struggle. Add 1-2 slides showing the challenge before the solution.
  • Use Arabic voiceover on Reels: Your Tue Reel should have Arabic VO, not text overlay. @shaam.architects does this (66 likes despite 0.04% ER)—voice = trust in this market.
  • Golden hour photography only: Your static posts lack dramatic lighting. Al Hamad Villa facade should be shot at sunset, not flat daylight.

🤝 Engagement Actions

  • Target @theromeera followers: They tagged you 3x last week (cafe posts). Reply to all 3, repost to Stories, DM owner to discuss collaboration (they're building lifestyle brand = potential Elite referrals).
  • Engage with #emirateshills top posts: Comment on the $95M mansion post (20,773 likes) and sl_architects' Emirates Hills project (9,382 likes). Your target clients are in those comment sections.
  • DM @referencedekho and @raymond.interior: Both reposted your work without direct tag. Thank them, ask to feature upcoming projects first. Free exposure to their 10K+ design-focused audiences.
  • Reply to every DM within 2 hours: Your Messages ads are driving conversations—speed = conversion in luxury. Assign 1 person to monitor 9am-9pm daily.

⚠️ What to Avoid

  • No more "technical showcase" carousels: Your "scale and material honesty" post (163 likes) and "earthy textures" post (62 likes) = lowest performers. Audience doesn't care about process, they care about outcomes.
  • Stop geo-targeting Sharjah in Awareness campaigns: Data shows it's a money pit. Focus AE-wide or Dubai/Abu Dhabi only.
  • Don't boost posts in English: Your Arabic ads outperform English 10:1. If you boost organics, Arabic-first.
  • Avoid hashtags like #MansionGoals / #Villa: Your engagement ad with these got 0.14% CTR. Too generic. Use niche tags like #EmiratesHills, #DubaiArchitecture.

📊 Success Metrics for This Week

  • Messages ad CTR: Maintain >2.5% on scaled Arabic ads (currently 2.58-3.89%)
  • Messages ad CPC: Keep under $1.20 (currently $0.33-$1.09)
  • Organic ER: Hit 0.5% average across all posts (currently 0.2-0.3%) — aim for 300+ likes, 5+ comments per post
  • Profile visits: Increase from 2,106 to 2,500+ (driven by scaled Messages ads)
  • New followers: 350+ (up from 329, quality over quantity)
  • Lead conversations: 40+ qualified DM conversations (track in CRM)
  • Ad spend efficiency: Total spend under $3,500 (kill Awareness waste, reallocate to Messages)
